user.title: Configure SmartPI Calculator
user.description: Direct valve control writes valve values and learns with confirmed application. Manual external control learns assuming you apply the output externally 1:1. Learning disabled only calculates: no writes or learning.

data.name: Name
data.hysteresis_on: Bootstrap: switch on this many °C below target
data.hysteresis_off: Bootstrap: switch off this many °C above target (0 = at target)

valves.title: Direct valve control
valves.description: Select existing opening and closing number entities in matching order and equal counts. With minimum 0, 40% becomes opening 40 / closing 60. Set per-radiator minima on the next page. Disable native Adaptive Mode and other writers of these valve values. RoomMind remains the target source.

valve_minima.title: Usable valve range
valve_minima.description: Set the start of the usable range per radiator. Default 0 preserves existing behavior. Zero demand closes fully; positive demand is rescaled to minimum–100%. For example minimum 30% and demand 5% gives 33.5% before rounding. Changing a minimum preserves samples and PI state unchanged. Learning quality gates still apply; monitor heating response and Last learning result.

error.invalid_minimum_opening: Use a finite minimum from 0 to less than 100% for each selected radiator.
error.invalid_hysteresis: Use distances from 0 to 2 °C, not both zero. These thresholds apply only during Hysteresis, not PI.
error.invalid_pairs: Select an equal, nonzero number of opening and closing entities.
error.duplicate_valves: Each valve entity must be unique.
error.valve_in_use: A selected valve already belongs to another SmartPI instance.
error.valve_is_source: A valve output cannot also be a temperature or target source.
error.invalid_valve_range: Valves must support 0–100 with a compatible step size.

abort.already_configured: A calculator for this room temperature source already exists.
